<script>
// ── Carousel ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
let shPos = 0;
const shCardW = 316;
function shSlide(dir) {
  const track = document.getElementById('shCarousel');
  const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.sh-card');
  const visible = window.innerWidth < 700 ? 1 : window.innerWidth < 1000 ? 2 : 3;
  const max = cards.length - visible;
  shPos = Math.max(0, Math.min(shPos + dir, max));
  track.style.transform = `translateX(-${shPos * shCardW}px)`;
}
</script>
